OIL INDIA LIMITED - DRILLING DEPARTMENT
DAILY DRILLING REPORT (DDR) - SCANNED COPY - SYNTHETIC DEMONSTRATION DOCUMENT
Well: DLJ-18
Field: Duliajan
Rig: CTR-SV2
Report No.: 117
Report Date: 2020- Spud Date: 2019- 
Depth @ 24:00: 2,993 m MD Hole Size: /4"
Well Type: deviated
Latitude: 27.4612 Longitude: 95.0595
1. OPERATIONS SUMMARY
00: :30 Drilled ahead /4" hole from 2,929 m; parameters steady.
03: :15 Connection, survey, circulated bottoms-up.
04: :45 Torque Spike at 2,951 m - see remarks. NPT 1.0 hrs.
09: :00 Conditioned hole, reamed interval, circulated hi-vis sweep.
13: :00 Drilled ahead at controlled parameters.
2. MUD PROPERTIES
MW 10.4 ppg FV 58 s PV 26 cP YP 24 1b/100ft2 pH 9.5 KC1-Po1ymer
3. DRILLING EVENTS / REMARKS
1. TORQUE SPIKE at 2,951 m MD (BARAIL) | Severity: LOW | NPT: 1.0 hrs | MW: 10.4 ppg
Torque spike to 15 kft-1b at 2,951 m MD (Barail); string stalled once before parameters were reduced.
Mitigation: Reduced WOB/RPM and circulated bottoms-up.
Lesson: Expect torque increase in Barail coal seams; pre-empt with lubricant and a stabilised BHA.
2. TIGHT HOLE at 2,975 m MD (BARAIL) | Severity: HIGH | NPT: 9.5 hrs | MW: 10.5 ppg
Tight hole at 2,975 m MD in Barail; overpull 70 k1bs on trip out, reaming required through 45 m
interval. Restricted movement after each connection.
Mitigation: Back-reamed interval, pumped hi-vis sweeps and raised mud inhibition (Kc1) to reduce clay
swelling.
Lesson: Ream on connections through Barail; do not wait for drag to increase.
4. LESSONS LEARNED
- Expect torque increase in Barail coal seams; pre-empt with lubricant and a stabilised BHA.
- Ream on connections through Barail; do not wait for drag to increase.
Prepared by: Drilling Engineer (synthetic) Reviewed by: Drilling Superintendent (synthetic)
